captions.detailed: This 3D model is a four-armed star-shaped support stand designed to hold a circular object such as a pot lid. It features a central vertical pin and four horizontal arms extending outward at specific angles. Each arm terminates in a small vertical peg, with one arm being slightly longer than the other three to accommodate a steam vent alignment.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric pot lid support stand in OpenSCAD. The design should feature a central vertical pin and four radiating support arms, with three arms acting as bowl supports and one arm specifically sized to locate a steam vent. Include parameters for the central pin diameter and height, the steam vent distance and height, and the outer bowl support radius.
captions.factory: The script defines a central cylinder as the main hub. It then uses a series of rotate and translate commands to position four rectangular support arms (created using the cube primitive) and their vertical pins (using cylinder primitives). One arm is configured for the steam vent location with custom dimensions, while the other three arms are rotated at 45, 165, and 285 degrees to serve as the bowl supports, each terminating in a dual-cylinder peg structure.
